notes.title: 📢 Crimson Quest Demo v1.5 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers!  
The Crimson Quest Demo has been updated to [b]v1.5[/b], bringing various improvements. This update introduces beginner-friendly features, new content, balance adjustments, and bug fixes.  

---

[h1]🆕Major Additions[/h1]

[b]🔹 Help System Added[/b]
[list]
[*] A new help system has been implemented to provide easy access to essential gameplay information.  
[*] Designed to make the game more accessible for beginners.  
[/list]

[b]🔹 Optional Objective System Added[/b]
[list]
[*] The optional objective system offers additional challenges and rewards.  
[*] Enjoy the game in more diverse ways beyond the main objectives.  
[/list]

[b]🔹 New Tower: Detection Tower[/b]
[list]
[*] The Detection Tower, which detects nearby objects, has been added.  
[*] Utilize this new strategic element to gain an advantage in battle!  
[/list]

---

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the death animation would not trigger when dying in an electrified state.  
[*] Fixed a bug where destroying a Stone Cannon for resources would cause the destruction animation to loop indefinitely.  
[/list]

---

[b]Balance Adjustments[/b]
Tower blueprint drop rate from red chests increased by 5%.
[list]
[*] Tower blueprints can now be obtained more easily.  
[/list]

---

[b]Play the updated Crimson Quest Demo now![/b]
Your feedback is invaluable to us. Enjoy the game, and don’t forget to add it to your wishlist!  

Thank you! 😊
